note_gaps: USPTO patent PDF section extracted no text and Wikipedia 404'd; every V3 claim comes from a Teslarati paraphrase of the patents, not patent text. The 22-DoF total (5 fingers x4 + 2 wrist) is the article's own arithmetic, not stated as such by Tesla. Gen 2's 11-DoF figure and V3's 22-DoF figure describe different, non-comparable generations; actuated DoF, weight, fingertip force and control rate are not stated for either.
actuation: V3: tendon-driven from forearm actuators, three tendons per finger through a crosstalk-managing wrist. Gen 2: in-hand actuators/sensors (unlocated in the article).
tactile: Gen 2: tactile sensing on all fingers, demonstrated matching contact location and force in an egg-pickup video; type/count not stated. V3: not stated.
claim_date: Gen 2 video 2023-12-13; V3 patents filed 2024-10, relayed by press 2026-04
spec_caveat: the 22 DoF in circulation is a Teslarati article's arithmetic of four DoF on each of five fingers plus two at the wrist, not a Tesla statement; Gen 2's own figure is 11 DoF. This row's actuation cell describes V3 and its tactile cell describes Gen 2
